A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 14-page PixDLM paper, including Appendices A–D and references. Pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered content; differences are confined to the first page.

before.justification: v1 reports original PixDLM evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–4, annotation-quality measurements in Appendix A.3, and additional benchmark results and ablations in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original model evaluations, annotation-quality measurements, and main-text and appendix ablation results.

M1.justification: The Dual-Path Vision Encoder, MultiPath Alignment, LLM/Mask Token processing, hierarchical decoder, and training losses are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same DRSeg reasoning subsets, RRSIS-D training ablation, and RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg evaluations. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Table 1, Figure 4, and Tables A.1–A.2. The supplementary Seg-Zero/GeoPix comparisons and referring-segmentation baselines already appear in v1.

E3.justification: The DRSeg 3:2:5 split, gIoU/cIoU metrics, zero-shot and supervised-fine-tuning comparisons, Section 5.1 training settings, and appendix evaluation procedures are identical.

E4.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same training-data/CoT, fusion-layer, and decoder-depth ablations. Appendix A.3 annotation verification, Appendix D fusion-direction and single-layer-decoder analyses, and qualitative examples are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Appendix A.3 annotation-quality summaries. Neither version reports repeated-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests for model performance.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 retains PixDLM gIoU/cIoU values of 62.80/62.84 for attribute, 61.75/64.03 for scene, and 62.51/62.80 for spatial reasoning; all supplementary result tables are unchanged.

T1.justification: The task definition, encoder/decoder equations (1)–(7), loss equation (8), and Appendix A.3 scoring definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about UAV reasoning segmentation, the DRSeg benchmark, and PixDLM's architecture and performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning structural-detail preservation, CoT supervision, hierarchical fusion, cross-domain generalization, and offline applicability are unchanged. No substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Training hyperparameters and hardware, annotation prompts, LoRA and trainable-component details, parameter counts, inference timing, and the code/data/model availability statement are identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper, and references [1]–[63] are unchanged. The positioning relative to earlier segmentation and multimodal methods is retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds a dagger identifying Changli Wu as Project leader and adjusts the corresponding-author superscript and footnote notation. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Small first-page typography and spacing changes accompany the revised author notation, expanded footnote, and updated arXiv version/date stamp. All figures, tables, captions, and rendered pages 2–14 are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies project-leader attribution and makes small first-page formatting changes. The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
